title: Concept: Remote artifact fetched without an integrity check during the build in dockerfile — review required
description: In dockerfile, ADD pulls a file from a URL. Docker fetches the content at build time and offers no integrity metadata for it, so the artifact depends entirely on transport and server trust. Builds are often cached, which means one compromised fetch can persist across many rebuilds.
applicability: dockerfile images that embed tools or vendor artifacts.
risk: Supply-chain substitution of build content; MEDIUM severity.
